lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized into roughly vertical columns of 3-5 units, forming a rectangular grid-like arrangement that extends from the branchial region toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the longitudinal carinae and high-luminance blobs, creating distinct grid-like nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features are visible along the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edges and deep shadows on the ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A distribution of high-luminance blobs is visible on the first dorsal fin, although pixel clarity decreases toward the trailing edge due to motion blur and distance from the sensor.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior margin of the first dorsal fin exhibits significant irregular notches and jagged tissue loss, indicating mechanical trauma or amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex whorl or maze-like configuration of high-luminance spots is visible on the upper flank immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, deviating from the standard grid pattern.
